| `getForwardedAriaAttribute`  | Returns the value of the given ARIA attribute on the forwarding target element. Because&#xA;\`ForwardAriaMixin` forwards ARIA attributes from the host to the target, this is where the actual&#xA;value ends up.                                                | `host: LitElement & ForwardAriaMixinInterface, name: string` | `string \| null`              |
| `getForwardedAriaProperty`   | Returns the value of the given ARIA property on the forwarding target element. This is useful for&#xA;element reference properties like `ariaLabelledByElements` or `ariaDescribedByElements` that&#xA;\`ForwardAriaMixin` forwards from the host to the target. | `host: LitElement & ForwardAriaMixinInterface, name: K`      | `HTMLElement[K] \| undefined` |
| `getForwardedDescription`    | Returns the accessible description for the given element that uses `ForwardAriaMixin`, following&#xA;the priority: aria-describedby → aria-description.                                                                                                          | `host: LitElement & ForwardAriaMixinInterface`               | `string`                      |
| `isForwardedDisabled`        | Returns the disabled state of the given element: - `false` if the element is not disabled -&#xA;\`true` if the element is natively disabled (the `disabled` attribute/property) - `'aria'` if the&#xA;element is disabled via `aria-disabled="true"`             | `host: LitElement & ForwardAriaMixinInterface`               | `false \| true \| 'aria'`     |

| `summary`  |         | `string \| undefined`  |         | A text shown in the header - as a title of the accordion item. |                |

### Methods

| -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------ | -------------- |

| `toggle` |         | Toggles the component state between open or closed. If the `force` parameter is provided, the&#xA;state will be set to the value of the parameter.                      | `force: boolean`        | `void` |                |

| --------- | -------------------------------------------- |

| `summary` | Header element of the accordion-item         |

| `classify`                 | Returns the UpperCamelCase form of a string.&#xA;&#xA;\```javascript&#xA;classify('innerHTML'); // 'InnerHTML'&#xA;classify('action_name'); // 'ActionName'&#xA;classify('css-class-name'); // 'CssClassName'&#xA;classify('my favorite items'); // 'MyFavoriteItems'&#xA;\```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `str: string`                   |        |
| `dasherize`                | Replaces underscores, spaces, or camelCase with dashes.&#xA;&#xA;\```javascript&#xA;dasherize('innerHTML'); // 'inner-html'&#xA;dasherize('action_name'); // 'action-name'&#xA;dasherize('css-class-name'); // 'css-class-name'&#xA;dasherize('my favorite items'); // 'my-favorite-items'&#xA;\```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `str: string`                   |        |
| `decamelize`               | Converts a camelized string into all lower case separated by underscores.&#xA;&#xA;\```javascript&#xA;decamelize('innerHTML'); // 'inner_html'&#xA;decamelize('action_name'); // 'action_name'&#xA;decamelize('css-class-name'); // 'css-class-name'&#xA;decamelize('my favorite items'); // 'my favorite items'&#xA;\```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `str: string`                   |        |
| `getCharacterPluralSuffix` | Returns the locale-specific pluralized form used for the "character" label. Uses Intl.PluralRules&#xA;API to determine the correct plural form for the current locale.&#xA;&#xA;Note: despite the historical name, this helper does not always return a literal suffix. Some&#xA;locales can require a full localized word or form rather than an English-style ending.&#xA;&#xA;\```javascript&#xA;getCharacterPluralSuffix(1)  // '' in English ("character"), but may be a full singular form in other locales&#xA;getCharacterPluralSuffix(2)  // 's' in English ("characters"), but may be a different localized plural form&#xA;getCharacterPluralSuffix(5)  // 's' in English ("characters"), but may be a different localized plural form | `count: number, locale: string` |        |
| `getPluralCategory`        | Returns the CLDR plural category for the given count and locale. Uses Intl.PluralRules to&#xA;determine the category. Falls back to a simple 'one'/'other' distinction if Intl.PluralRules is&#xA;not supported.&#xA;&#xA;\```javascript&#xA;getPluralCategory(1); // 'one'&#xA;getPluralCategory(2); // 'other' in English, 'few' in Polish&#xA;getPluralCategory(5); // 'other' in English, 'many' in Polish&#xA;\```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `count: number`                 |        |
| `humanize`                 | Returns the Humanized form of a string&#xA;&#xA;\```javascript&#xA;humanize('innerHTML'); // 'Inner html'&#xA;humanize('action_name'); // 'Action name'&#xA;humanize('css-class-name'); // 'Css class name'&#xA;humanize('my favorite items'); // 'My favorite items'&#xA;\```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `str: string`                   |        |
| `underscore`               | More general than decamelize. Returns the lower_case_and_underscored form of a string.&#xA;&#xA;\```javascript&#xA;underscore('innerHTML'); // 'inner_html'&#xA;underscore('action_name'); // 'action_name'&#xA;underscore('css-class-name'); // 'css_class_name'&#xA;underscore('my favorite items'); // 'my_favorite_items'&#xA;\```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `str: string`                   |        |
